name: VBench
intro: VBench 是视频生成模型的综合评测套件，LongCat-Video 与 ERNIE 报告用它比较视频生成质量。
build_method: 16个解耦维度, 维度特定提示与指标, 人类偏好一致性验证
metric: 16 dimension scores, Quality Score, Semantic Score
build_method_en: 16 disentangled dimensions, dimension-specific prompts and metrics, human-preference alignment validation
intro_en: VBench is a comprehensive benchmark suite for video generative models, used by LongCat-Video and ERNIE reports to compare video generation quality.
metric_en: 16 dimension scores, Quality Score, Semantic Score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with VBench arXiv:2311.17982, Sections 3-5; official Vchitect/VBench repository. VBench decomposes text-to-video generation quality into 16 hierarchical, disentangled dimensions spanning video quality and condition consistency. For each dimension, the authors design a targeted prompt suite across content categories and pair it with a specialized automatic metric. Candidate video models generate outputs from the same prompts. Human annotators receive dimension-specific instructions, compare generated videos while ignoring irrelevant qualities, and create preference data used to validate alignment between each automatic metric and human perception. VBench reports fine-grained dimension and content-category scores plus an overall quality and semantic score, exposing model-specific strengths and weaknesses.
